final_caller: So, how do I register for a tin number with ORA?
final_assistant:
Happy to help you register for a T-I-N!

To register for a T-I-N with U-R-A in Uganda: 1. Visit the official U-R-A web portal 2. Navigate to eServices T-I-N Registration 3. Complete the online application form and submit.
Are you registering as an individual (requires your National ID/N-I-N) or an organisation (requires Certificate of Incorporation)?

results.spoken_notice: I'm connecting you to a URA officer, please hold.

en_vat_accuracy.text: The standard rate of Value Added Tax (V-A-T) in Uganda is 18 percent on taxable supplies of goods and services.

lg_vat_accuracy.text: Okusasula omusolo gwa takisi, olina okwewandiisa ne U-R-A n'ofuna nnamba ya U-R-A. Oluvannyuma osasula ssente z'okwewandiisa emitwalo 20 n'olukusa lw'omwaka olwa 120,000. Kakasa nti otuukiriza ebisaanyizo bino okwewala engassi. Wandiyagadde okwogera n'omukozi ku nsonga eno?

sw_tin_accuracy.text:
Ninafurahi kukusaidia kujisajili kwa ajili ya T-I-N! Kusajiliwa kwa T-I-N na U-R-A nchini Uganda:
Hatua 1: Tembelea tovuti rasmi ya U-R-A kwenye 2. Nenda kwenye eServices Usajili wa T-I-N 3. Jaza fomu ya maombi mtandaoni na uwasilishe. Je! Ungependa maelezo zaidi?
